stopped.reason: With the 3.8 image the pins of requirements.txt were resolved up to the line 'tf-nightly' (unpinned). PyPI metadata (every release of tf-nightly) lists wheels only for cp310 to cp314, while tensorflow==2.4.0, pinned in the same file, has wheels only up to cp38. No image satisfies both lines of the repository's file, and removing a line is an edit of the repository.
